slice.name: M token held by RISE Dollar

name: RISE Dollar
oneLiner: RISE's USDR wraps M0's M on RISE; public conversion is to wM, while direct M output requires an approved swapper.
collateral: M0 M tokens held by the chain-local extension; the M parent provides the Treasury-backed issuance and custody layer.
pegMechanism: M-extension wrapping and unwrapping conserve the deposited M claim. The current SwapFacility restricts direct M output to approved swappers; an unprivileged sample canSwapViaPath(child,wM) returned true while child-to-M returned false. This is technical conversion eligibility, not a sent transaction or a cash redemption right.

proofOfReserves.provider: On-chain parent-token custody; not independent financial assurance

dependencyReview.rationale: At rise block 23375290, symbol/decimals and EIP-1967 implementation/admin were re-read. Local backing balance was 4,186,507.178834 M against 4,166,902.771484 USDR supply. M-extension wrapping and unwrapping conserve the deposited M claim. The current SwapFacility restricts direct M output to approved swappers; an unprivileged sample canSwapViaPath(child,wM) returned true while child-to-M returned false. This is technical conversion eligibility, not a sent transaction or a cash redemption right. The exact deployment launch date is 2026-05-12, established by the first-code block boundary. The Guardian report dated 2025-12-12 covers JMI and changes to MYieldToOne, Freezable and SwapFacility at its named audit commits; this is framework corroboration, not exact deployed-commit certification, custody assurance or reserve-to-liability audit.

relationships.reason: The immediate serial claim is the verified parent stablecoin, not a direct child allocation of off-chain Treasury reserves.
